title: metadata-client: `reset()` cannot name a package — after objectstack#23165 a console reset or discard of an item two packages hold answers 409, and the remedy `?package=` is one the console cannot send
body:
Blocked-by: #12370

Restart-when: `npm view @objectstack/rest@next time --json` lists a version published after 2026-10-13T15:54:13Z, the merge of objectstack `543b33dee`, i.e. one whose `DELETE /api/v1/meta/TYPE/NAME` accepts `?package=`

Filing gate: cross-repo rule 3. An accepted objectstack PR's product flows into this repo, and the accepting seat files the consumer's follow-up when it lands. This card is held (`pm:on-hold`) until the release is installable: against today's released server, a `DELETE` carrying `?package=` is refused 400 as an unknown parameter, so sending it early would break every reset. The `Restart-when:` line above is the unlock criterion; objectstack-ai/objectui#12030 (objectui onto the `next` prereleases) is the path by which it reaches this repo.

Filed by objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#18549) · `os-justin` · session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H`. ⛔ Not a claim. Reader who acts: objectui triage, to route it. The upstream PR body named objectstack-ai/objectui#12300 as this half's carrier, but #12300 closed at 07:26Z (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12313), before the upstream door existed, so this card carries it.

## What landed upstream

- objectstack-ai/objectstack#23165 (triage direction `6141939797`, option B under ADR-0070) was carried by PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23290, merged as `543b33dee` at 2026-10-13T15:54Z.
- A save or delete that names no package now addresses the one package that holds the item. When two or more packages hold the name, it is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, naming them, with `?package=` as the remedy; nothing is written or deleted.
- `DELETE /api/v1/meta/TYPE/NAME?package=PACKAGE_ID` is new: before it, the delete door could not name a package at any layer. The delete receipt names the package it removed from, and names the row still stored when another one remains.

## The reader here, measured at objectui `origin/main` `72594f29`

- `packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts`, `reset()`: it sends `DELETE` with `?state=draft` at most, and never a package. `save()` and `publish()` in the same file already send `?package=` when the item is package-bound, with one spelling for both.
- Its callers: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx:1805` (reset) and `:1884` (discard draft), `packages/app-shell/src/views/runtime-metadata-persistence.ts:356` (discard draft), and `packages/plugin-designer/src/MetadataObjectsPage.tsx:213` (reset an object); plus Setup › Apps' delete, which objectstack-ai/objectui#12300 made honest about `reset: false`.
- So after the release, a console reset or discard of an item two packages hold answers 409 with a remedy the console cannot send.

## Acceptance

Run on the installed release:

- `reset()` takes a `packageId` option and sends `?package=` when it is set, omitted (never empty) when it is not, the spelling `save()` and `publish()` use.
- Each caller above that knows the item's package binding passes it. A caller that does not know it keeps the package-less call, and a 409 from it is shown with its remedy, not swallowed.
- Pins: a reset of a package-bound item sends `?package=`; a package-less reset sends none; a 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` reaches the user as an error.
- The SDK side, `@objectstack/client`'s `meta.deleteItem`, is objectstack-ai/objectstack#23293 and is not this card.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included: `metadata client reset delete package query parameter console discard draft two packages 409` → 6 hits, all closed: #12300 (the Setup › Apps half named above), #11784, #11797, #11203, #5359 and #2555, about other delete, discard and draft questions. None is this.

Dedupe words: metadata-client reset no package; DELETE meta package query; console discard draft two packages 409.
